description: Land Title Settlement Department - Notice Calling for claims to Land Parcels Palagala D/S Division
categorisation: This gazette content deals exclusively with land-related matters, specifically calling for claims to ownership/possession/interest in specific land parcels under the Registration of Title Act. It involves land title determination, cadastral maps, and land settlement procedures, which falls squarely under the Land Gazettes category (Type 4) for land and property-related matters.
